This match is followed by a five-match ODI series between the two sides as the visitors continue their tour of New Zealand. The last time these two sides met in a T20 series in this country was in a three-match contest in late 2022. The first matched was abandoned due to rain before India won the second game comprehensively by 65 runs. The final contest ended in a tie to give India a 1-0 victory.
